name: Jp-Holdings,Inc.
summary: Jp-Holdings,Inc. provides childcare support services in Japan. The company is involved in the operation of child-rearing support facilities, such as nursery schools, after-school clubs, and children's centers, as well as community centers; and development and provision of programs comprising English, gymnastics, music, eurhythmics, and early childhood learning programs. It also engages in the provision of meals for child-rearing support facilities, and advisory services regarding meals; conduction of training and research on childcare and child development; and planning and sale of childcare-related products, such as toy shelves and picture bookshelves.
